newsitem.title: USA: SoCal Edison brings power lines back up.
newsitem.headline: SoCal Edison brings power lines back up.

text.p: Edison International's Southern California Edison unit resumed at 1515 PDT operation of the two 500 kilovolt interstate power lines that went down on Monday evening during a fire.
Edison spokesman Steve Conroy said the company expects to return the lines to normal operating rates at around 1700 PDT.

"The fire is not impacting the lines right now, but we are waiting to make sure about its direction before" returning the lines to full schedules, said Conroy. The lines, two of the three that link Edison's southern California territory to the Pacific Northwest, are now operating near 700 megawatts.
